subject: FinPay - Stakeholder map & MAP next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpay.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finpay.com>
Cc: camila_reyes, dylan_brooks
Date: 2027-04-10T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: FinPay - Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Hi Laura / Tom -

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary decision criteria: total cost of ownership (TCO), latency on 2k token prompts, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.
- Economic buyer: Ravi Singh (CFO) per Laura; procurement & legal will own commercial/redlines.
- Security reviewer: internal security team (you mentioned a lead and a questionnaire).

Proposed MAP (milestones):
1) Stakeholder confirmation - list economic buyer + procurement + security owners (this email) - due: 4/12
2) Security questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts sent to FinPay - due: 4/15
3) Tech deep-dive (redwood demo + perf targets) - proposed week of 4/19
4) Commercial term sheet and procurement review - due: 4/26
5) Contract sign / pilot kickoff - target: 5/10

I attached a first-pass Stakeholder Map + MAP (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) and my call notes (discovery-notes.md). Please confirm the stakeholders and any other decision criteria we should include.

If that looks good I'll update the MAP and schedule the tech deep-dive with Camila and Dylan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), discovery-notes.md (text)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finpay.com>, procurement@finpay.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinPay - Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the thorough recap - this is exactly what we needed. Quick notes:
- Confirmed economic buyer: Ravi Singh (CFO) - I'll introduce you if/when we get to commercial.
- Procurement point: Tom Alvarez (cc'ed) will own RFP/procurement timeline.
- Security: please send the SOC2 evidence and any standard answers to our questionnaire; our security team will intake.

Decision timeline: our target is to have vendor selection completed by end of May, but procurement needs to run the full review.

Availability: I can do a tech deep-dive with your team on 4/20 at 10:00am PT. Tom and procurement will join if available.

Thanks - looping Tom + procurement.

Best,
Laura
Head of Product, FinPay
laura.chen@finpay.com

From: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole, dylan_brooks
Date: 2027-04-12T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FinPay - Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (internal)

Quick internal notes -

Thanks - great call. Suggested updates before we send MAP v2 to FinPay:
- Add a "Security intake" milestone (send SOC2 + control matrix) with a 3-business-day turnaround once FinPay requests artifacts. We can mention we'll provide standard evidence & a sandbox perf report.
- Add Procurement milestone: procurement questionnaire completion and redline window (we should propose 5 business days for first pass).
- Tech deep-dive agenda: 20 min perf targets (latency/throughput), 20 min demo (streaming + tool-calling), 20 min Q&A, plus alignment on integration (API vs Private deployment).

Also flag: if they need custom quantization/ops work for latency targets we may need to involve infra team - potential impact to timeline and pricing; hold space in MAP for "Runtime optimization evaluation".

I'll help draft the MAP v2; Marissa, if you want I can own the technical agenda and send a calendar invite for 4/20 at 10am PT.

- Camila
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Hi Laura / Tom -

Per our thread and internal sync, attached is MAP v2 (FinPay_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the security & procurement milestones added and an initial timeline aligned to your selection target. Highlights:
- Security intake: SOC2 + control matrix shared within 3 business days of request.
- Procurement redline window: 5 business days for first pass; we'll surface any required legal exceptions to your team.
- Tech deep-dive scheduled: 4/20 at 10:00am PT (Camila + Dylan leading).

Please review MAP v2 and confirm the stakeholder owners for each milestone (economic buyer, procurement owner, security reviewer). I've also included a HubSpot link to the deal and a DocuSign NDA if we need one pre-demo: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FP-2027-037 / DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/finpay-nda (stub).
